notes: This manifest contains only texture images that function as entity/model UV atlases or UV-aligned entity material/state/overlay layers.
Non-UV assets are excluded from this queue: particles/effect sprites, HUD/formspec images, spawn icons/egg templates, projectiles, rails/boats/paintings and other flat sprites.
Variant/state/overlay files remain separate entries when they map onto entity/model UV coordinates; they are not collapsed by mob family.
Pass 1: strict structure-locked prompt creates a high-quality UV atlas from the original texture.
Pass 2: use the HQ UV atlas as Image A and a creature-specific visual reference as Image B; preserve UV/anatomical structure while transferring material appearance.
Original source alpha/occupancy mask remains the application-side final structural guard.
